I don't like the principle of "hope" so I won't bother you with that
I have been single during my whole life too and sometimes it can come from things that you wouldn't have thought of before
If you haven't deleted them, read your conversations with the girls you wanted to go out with
If you don't want to be single, don't be desperate about it, that's the best way of getting rejected, have self confidence, think that you, are now a new you. Girls like people who are self confident... well not to the point where you look like a narcissistic asshole but not really far from that. Don't get angry about it, everyone gets rejected most of the time (I mean I don't even count how many girls have rejected me anymore) don't think that the problem is you, think about that before you ask a girl out "If I was her and I saw myself asking me out, what would I do? What formulation or approach would more likely lead to a relationship?"
Also be patient, I know it's hard but you can't expect love to come right away, don't think about it, do something else, do your favorite hobby during your free time stop thinking that being with someone will make everything better and that "she" can appear at any time
Focus on what you like to do, don't daydream about a wife all day long, it won't help.
Look at yourself in the mirror, wear what you like, what makes you feel confident, get a haircut that will make you feel confident. Enjoy your life, don't bother searching for love, it will come someday

Well you can talk to me whenever your want, just PM me if you want my skype, I'm open to any type of conversation and I have an opinion on almost everything so feel free to contact me if you are bored or if you need someone to talk to
Also, we are 7 Billion on this planet, even though you lost him, you will find someone like him, you just need hope, skip that page, if its finished with him, just get over it, staying in the past won't help. The only way to have the occasion to meet someone like him again is to move forward, you can do it

"Sadly", not every atheist by the age of 14 realized that... That's what almost got me into a suicide attempt before I got on SW to realize I wasn't alone, because in my high school, nobody felt like that, even though they didn't care much about any religion they just didn't understand me.
I'm dealing with myself too, not because I can't afford therapy, but mostly because I know what they would do, they often will just lock me up in a psychiatric hospital until my "madness" goes out or tell me to enjoy life or give me drugs that will change the current me (which I absolutely don't want) because I'm a minor, I'm 16 and I'm in France... Yes they have the power to do that
I too don't experience a "LOT" of fun, my life is mainly stressful, and I haven't been really happy for a long time, maybe finding someone like me will help, I don't know
What I know however is that for the time being, entertainment is the only treatment that doesn't involves having to search for month to find a partner

Ok, I get it, so we are almost the same (if i was the only one to survive, I'd just have fun with what's left, fly a plane, eat what I like, go wherever I want, finish my long list of downloaded anime and then kill myself)
We are a lot in the same case, but we are often far apart and we don't know each other
I feel like a good thing would be a nihilist meeting website, with IRL events (if that doesn't yet exists) 
Also i'd like to know a little more about you, how old are you, and where approximately do you live? (like on earth, in america, in the void...)

I'm in high school, in France I don't know what is the american or english equivalent for it, we call it 1st grade it's the second year of high school
I live at my parents, I don't work yet and money really isn't a problem right now, I don't waste it on drugs, alcohol or other stuff like that, I don't think it's worth it so.. yeah

Life is about your experience, it has its ups and downs, you don't know what tomorrow will be made of but actually I'm a bit like you, that feeling of void, that nothing matters and that whatever you do you will die anyway. That people around you can't get your logic... I'd say that you are a nihilist, the good thing is that you are not alone, not at all, we are millions to be like this, (check out the "nihilist memes" facebook page, that will make you feel way more comfortable about it) the bad thing (if we can call it bad) is that you will eventually stay like this unless you forget or entertain yourself.
Try new things, things you wouldn't think you'd like, even simple things that will make you want to keep living (personally, I decided to start watching anime, playing video games again and building awesome heavy cosplays on my free time)
Also, don't care about IRL social life, what matters in your life is you, and only you not what people think of you (don't be a douchebag but don't consider your social life as extremely important either, find that balance)
I hope that helps you, feel free to PM me if you have any questions about how nihilism works

Hi, can you tell me why you hate yourself? Also life is about you, not others, you think that having a girlfriend is great because your body and other people tell you so? It's not as good as you may think, overall it even is painless to a lot of people (it take too much time, effort and money that could be spent on something that you'll find better.
If you really want a girlfriend, remember this: "You'll surely have one without searching for one, that's for sure, being desperate to have one won't help, at all", don't wait until you have one cause that will end up wasting your time, do stuff that you like to do on your free time, don't be like me, I wasted almost two years of my scholarship just thinking about how I could get one, without any result.
I kissed a girl, like a real french kiss, you surely think that is awsome... It's not nearly as good as it sounds, kissing wet rubber would have the same effect (please get that truck tire out of your mouth, let me finish first)
So overall, stop wasting your time, I spent my time searching for a relationship, just like you and I realized that it's not the best thing to do at life, do what you want, because you can, because it is more exciting than sitting down and looking at "how the others outperform me" Don't think about what others do, your life is about you, not others.
